tinyplex-tinybase-build-with-tinybase.description: Scaffold, extend, and verify reactive local-first JavaScript or TypeScript applications with TinyBase. Use when choosing TinyBase for in-memory tabular or key-value state, generating an app with create-tinybase, adding schemas or UI bindings, resolving TinyBase import paths, configuring browser or database persistence, configuring MergeableStore synchronization over WebSockets or Cloudflare Durable Objects, or diagnosing an existing TinyBase application.
